customers.evidence: Each new generation would be increasingly affordable, helping the company work towards its mission

environment.evidence: Tesla’s mission is to accelerate the world’s transition to sustainable energy.

community.evidence: helping to improve robustness of the electrical grid, reduce energy costs for businesses and residences

innovation.evidence: a technology and design company with a focus on energy innovation

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, mission-led framing that puts sustainable energy first, then product performance and affordability. Mostly third-person corporate voice with a founding narrative. Many product specifications are factual rather than value statements. Commitments are stated absolutely, with few hedges. Employees, governance and integrity are essentially absent.
